note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the original describes only the soldier, records the alate as unknown and does not treat the worker, so the entry is correspondingly short; synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown, antennae pale brown, mandibles pale reddish brown, pronotum slightly paler than head capsule; head and body sparsely pilose. Head capsule subrectangular, widest in the anterior part, length to mandible base 0.87–1.16 mm, maximum width 0.81–0.90 mm; apex of frontal projection narrowly rounded, anterior margin medially concave, not reaching beyond the mandible base. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Anterior margin of labrum weakly narrowed. Mandibles slender, rod-like, apex curved inwards, longer than head capsule, left mandible length 1.25–1.33 mm. Postmentum rod-like, short, length 0.44 mm, maximum width 0.25–0.27 mm. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, length 0.16–0.29 mm, maximum width 0.39–0.46 mm, anterior margin not concave or only weakly concave.
